crossRefs.note: A young man ran, and told Moses, and said, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp!”

people.name: Eldad
people.line: Prophet who prophesied in the Israelite camp

people.name: Medad
people.line: Eldad's companion who prophesied in the Israelite camp.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

translations.web: A young man ran, and told Moses, and said, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp!”
translations.bsb: A young man ran and reported to Moses, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp.”
translations.kjv: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.
translations.asv: And there ran a young man, and told Moses, and said, Eldad and Medad do prophesy in the camp.
